params.name: Lag Time
params.desc: Doubletracker offset between reference and lag decks

params.name: Wobble
params.desc: Doubletrakcer adds random modulation to lag deck

params.name: Blend
params.desc: Doubletracker blend between reference and lag decks, larger value is more lag deck, middle is even blend

params.name: Doubletracker Boost/Cut
params.desc: -3 dB to +3dB on doubletracker for precise level matching

params.name: Auto-Flange Time
params.desc: Sweep time for auto flange effect

params.name: Wide Stereo Mode On/Off
params.desc: Generate wide stereo image sending reference deck to left out and lag deck to right out

params.name: MIDI Clock Tempo Mult/Div
params.desc: When synced to MIDI clock, mult/div of incoming tempo: x2/3, x1, x2, x3, x4, x6, and x8

params.name: MIDI Expression On/Off
params.desc: Enable/disable MIDI Expression via CC 100 (Expression Pedal)

params.name: Remote Tap
params.desc: Set lag time via tap tempo

params.name: Expression Pedal
params.desc: Sends expression pedal values, the parameters affected must be configured per the manual
